parameters.name: Input Wet
parameters.description: Adjusts the input level sent to the delay engine. Useful for automating 'Dub Throws'.

parameters.name: Time
parameters.description: Delay time. Units change to 'Step' when Tempo Sync is ON.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Stereo offset. Delays L or R channel relative to main time.

parameters.name: Filter Cutoff
parameters.description: Frequency of the filter inside the feedback loop.

parameters.name: Sample Rate
parameters.description: Downsampling quality. Low values create metallic aliasing.

parameters.name: Mod Time
parameters.description: Amount of pitch wobble applied to delay repeats.

parameters.name: Diffusion Level
parameters.description: Smearing amount. Turns echoes into reverb.

parameters.name: Distortion Threshold
parameters.description: Input level required to trigger saturation.
